biography: Stephanie Gear's journey began not on a track, but on the dusty dirt roads of rural Oklahoma. Her father, a mechanic, instilled a love for speed and precision early on, rebuilding engines in their backyard garage. Instead of dolls, Stephanie disassembled carburetors. Her entry into racing was almost accidental. At 19, she filled in for an injured driver in a local stock car race and stunned everyone, including herself, by winning. That unexpected victory ignited a fire. Stephanie quickly climbed the ranks, fueled by raw talent and relentless determination. A defining moment came at the 'Daytona Double' in 2020. Battling a severe flu, she gutted out a second-place finish, proving her mental fortitude. Despite flashes of brilliance and a few high-profile wins with Chevrolet, Stephanie's inconsistency has been her Achilles' heel, preventing her from reaching true championship contention. Now, at 32, she is fighting to prove her place in the upper echelons of the sport and shed the 'inconsistent' label.
drivingStyle: Stephanie's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward approach. She's known for late-braking maneuvers and aggressive corner entries, often pushing her car to the absolute limit. While this boldness yields spectacular overtakes, it also leads to costly errors and tire degradation. Her tire management is considered her biggest weakness, often burning through rubber in the first half of a race. Under pressure, Stephanie can either rise to the occasion with clutch performances or crumble under the weight, explaining her inconsistent results.

rivalries.reason: A clash of personalities and racing styles. Marco, known for his calculated precision, openly criticizes Stephanie's aggressive tactics, leading to several on-track altercations.
A fierce battle for Chevrolet's top spot. Both drivers are highly competitive and vying for the team's resources and attention, creating tension both on and off the track.

Stephanie and Kaze have a long history of close finishes and heated battles. Kaze respects Stephanie's raw speed, but their intense competition often results in thrilling, yet sometimes controversial, races.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of racing gloves gifted to her by her father.
Listens to a specific classic rock song (Highway Star) before every race, no matter what.
Sharpens her own pencils meticulously before every practice session, claiming it helps her focus.
famousQuote: You can't be afraid to break a few rules to win. But you gotta be smart about it.
careerHighlight: Winning the Indianapolis Invitational in 2021. Battling from the back of the grid after a qualifying incident, Stephanie executed a series of daring overtakes in the closing laps to take the checkered flag.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the championship-deciding race at Sonoma in 2022, costing her a potential title victory and earning her a reputation for faltering under pressure.
